name: 1-Wire temperature sensor, TO-92
summary: Measures −55 °C to +125 °C on a 1-Wire bus, from 3.0–5.5 V.

pinout.label: VDD
pinout.note: Ground this pin for parasite power

not_included: No pull-up resistor. Not the waterproof probe.

faq.a: 3.0–5.5 V, so the bus works at 3.3 V and at 5 V.
Yes. Each sensor has its own 64-bit address.

faq.q: Does the bag include a pull-up?
faq.a: No. DQ is open drain. The datasheet drawing uses 4.7 kΩ, and the text calls the bus pull-up about 5 kΩ.

faq.q: What is pin 3 in parasite power?
faq.a: Ground. The datasheet says VDD must be grounded in parasite-power mode.
No. The bag is a loose TO-92. A waterproof probe is a different part.

images.alt: DS18B20 sensor in a TO-92 package, black body with three metal leads.
images.note: Representative studio photograph, not a photo of the lot in the drawer.

in_the_bag: Loose TO-92 in an antistatic bag.
description: DS18B20 1-Wire thermometer in TO-92. −55 °C to +125 °C, ±0.5 °C from −10 °C to +85 °C. Each sensor has a 64-bit address, so more than one can share a bus. DQ needs a pull-up, which is not in the bag. A waterproof probe is a different part, available on request. Sourced from Hall Road, Lahore.
